candidates.rationale: Jesus teaches that a builder must count the cost and plan carefully before starting a tower, lest he lay a foundation but cannot finish.
This proverb instructs to prepare your work outside and get fields ready before building your house, emphasizing proper sequencing and foundation.
Paul warns that each builder must be careful how they build on the foundation, as the quality of their work will be tested.
Jesus contrasts the wise man who builds his house on rock with the foolish man who builds on sand, illustrating the importance of solid foundations over shortcuts.
The people rebuilt Jerusalem's wall with wholehearted dedication, showing commitment to thorough, quality work rather than hasty patches.
